A private studio, not a walk in shop floor.

Votive Tattoos opened its doors in Long Beach as a female owned private studio. Private means the room is yours for the session. No row of chairs, no crowd watching, just the work and the conversation around it.

The studio sits on Second Street in Belmont Shore, and booking runs by appointment, so every piece gets its own time, from a small flash design to a full realism piece planned over more than one sitting.

21 Nov
2026

Grand opening, Saturday 21 November 2026. The opening day brought flash tattoos and piercings to Second Street, and the studio has been booking from there since.

The signature

It starts as one line.

Every fine line piece begins the same way, a single unbroken stroke that has to land exactly right. Keep scrolling and watch it happen, stem first, then the branches, then the smallest leaves last.

That patience is the whole studio in one drawing. Nothing rushed, nothing filled in before its turn.

Botanical fine line, in progressStem

What happens in the room

Tattoos first, with piercings and nail art alongside. Keep scrolling and the room opens sideways.

Ask about a piece

Fine line tattoos

Delicate, precise linework. Botanical pieces, small symbols and designs that sit light on the skin.

Realism tattoos

Black and grey realism with soft shading and depth, planned with the studio before the first session.

Flash tattoos

Ready made designs from the studio flash sheets, drawn to be tattooed as they are. Flash was part of the grand opening day, and new sheets arrive as the studio creates them.

Piercings

Piercings in the same private room, including the lobe and nostril piercings offered at the opening.

Nail art

Detailed nail art to finish the visit, from simple colour to full patterned sets.

Close enough to see the hand in it

Fine line work rewards a close look. So does realism. This is the scale the studio works at, every day. Photos on this demo page are illustrative of each service.

More work, flash sheets and opening announcements live on Instagram, where the studio posts first.
